card.name: Devil's Sword Dance
card.tagline: Demon-masked Buddhist sword dance of Kitakami
card.profile: The Devil's Sword Dance (Onikenbai) is a folk sword dance handed down mainly in Kitakami and Oshu, Iwate Prefecture, in northeastern Japan, usually performed by a group of about eight dancers (Wikipedia, Devil's sword dance). Performers wear fierce oni (demon) masks that represent aspects of the Buddhist deity Fudo Myoo and dance dynamically with sword and fan to taiko drums, flute and kane, stomping and leaping; it is formally a type of Nenbutsu Kenbai performed as a prayer to ward off evil, comfort the dead and ensure good harvests (ANA; JeePe). Masks come in colours (red, blue, yellow, black, white) linked to directions and seasons.
card.insight: Onikenbai was designated an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property of Japan in 1993 and, in November 2022, was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List as part of the collective 'Furyu-odori' listing (41 ritual dances from 24 prefectures) (JeePe; Nippon.com).
